prompts.text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production sprite sheet of task-specific animated pixel cursors.
Reference image is identity and pixel-style reference ONLY: same Diana/嘉然, light brown long hair, pink bow, tiny gold star hair clip, blue eyes, pink cardigan, pale yellow skirt. Redesign her actions, do not copy the unrelated facial-expression collage.
Create one precisely organized 4 columns x 4 rows transparent sprite sheet. Each equal-sized square cell contains the SAME tiny full-body chibi girl at the SAME scale and centered anchor, complete body with generous transparent margins, planted feet on the same baseline within its row. True chunky 48x48 pixel art, dark plum pixel contour, limited pastel palette, no soft painting or antialiasing. No text, labels, borders, extra characters or watermark.
Each row is ONE continuous animation of ONE mouse-cursor function. Four columns are consecutive keyframes, small coherent limb changes, no identity changes, no sudden costume/view changes. No flying hearts, random jumping, sleeping pillows or unrelated props.
ROW 1 / LINK: girl facing slightly left, extending one hand with index finger clearly pointing toward upper left like inviting a click. Frames: hand close to chest; reaches forward; index finger taps a tiny sparkle near hand; withdraws halfway. Friendly attentive eyes, recognizable clear pointing gesture, not generic waving.
ROW 2 / WAIT: girl sits patiently holding a small real hourglass in both hands and looking at it. Frames show very subtle breathing and her gaze following sand falling, shoulders shift just 1 pixel. Awake, patient, not sleeping, no pillow, no jumping.
ROW 3 / FORBIDDEN: girl faces forward with BOTH palms held toward viewer in a clear STOP gesture. Frames head center, tilted left, center, tilted right; hands remain out. A gentle serious pout, not shy hands on cheeks, not smiling invitation.
ROW 4 / TEXT: girl quietly holds a small open book at chest height. Frames eyes looking down; blink closed; eyes reading; tiny one-hand page turn. Body stationary, no bounce. This must read clearly as quiet text work.
High quality production game sprite keyframes. Each row must depict its specific action clearly through the girl's own limbs and props, not a generic character with separate UI badges. Preserve the reference identity, keep exact uniform grid. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no checkerboard or matte.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production task-specific pixel cursor sprite sheet, four resize directions.
Image 1 is an identity and style reference ONLY. Same tiny Diana/嘉然 with light brown long hair, big pink bow, gold star hairclip, blue eyes, pink cardigan, pale yellow skirt, dark shoes. Consistent chunky 48x48 sprite language.
Make exactly 4 columns x 4 rows of equally sized square transparent cells. One complete small chibi full-body girl per cell with generous empty margin, identical scale and camera, aligned planted feet, facing front/slightly three-quarter as action needs. Each row is a distinct four-keyframe LOOP showing physical effort on a small double-headed arrow prop. Keep the same direction of the prop throughout the row. Four columns show hands pull close, extend, full extension, relax halfway. Face shows cute concentration, NOT random wink, waving, flying, dancing, jumping, happy hearts, pillows or idle poses.
ROW 1: HORIZONTAL RESIZE. She grips the ends of a horizontal left-right double arrow at chest level, stretches arms horizontally, feet remain planted. Clear left/right pushing-pulling.
ROW 2: VERTICAL RESIZE. She grips a vertical up-down double arrow in front of body with one hand higher than the other, reaches upward then lowers hands. Clear lifting/lowering, no jumping.
ROW 3: NORTHWEST-SOUTHEAST RESIZE. Both hands stretch a diagonal arrow from UPPER LEFT to LOWER RIGHT across her body. Arms and lean follow this exact diagonal, not horizontal or vertical.
ROW 4: NORTHEAST-SOUTHWEST RESIZE. Both hands stretch the opposite diagonal arrow from LOWER LEFT to UPPER RIGHT. Must be visibly the OTHER diagonal, not a duplicate of row 3.
The prop is small and tasteful, dark outline with cream/pink fill, physically held in her hands. The character limb motion itself should express the cursor task. Every consecutive frame in a row must keep identical character proportions, costume, hair details, baseline, scale; only limbs and tiny pose changes animate. True low-resolution pixel-art clusters, limited palette, stepped dark plum pixel outline, no smoothing or 3D. Transparent alpha background with no checkerboard, no text, no grid lines, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production sprite sheet for four functional animated pixel cursors.
Reference image is identity/style reference ONLY. Same tiny chibi Diana/嘉然: brown long hair, pink bow, golden star clip, blue eyes, pink cardigan, pale yellow dress and dark shoes. Preserve costume, silhouette and scale.
Precisely 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 equal transparent square cells; each row is one four-keyframe continuous action loop. Small coherent limb changes between columns, identical camera and feet baseline in a row. Full body completely visible in each cell, generous transparent margins, nothing crossing cells. Genuine chunky low-resolution 48x48 pixel game sprites, limited pastel palette, dark plum stepped pixel edges. No gradients, soft illustration, text labels, grid lines, watermark, extra people or unrelated hearts.
ROW 1 HELP: girl holds a tiny magnifying glass near her face, leans her head curiously toward it. Frames neutral curious; head slightly left with glass raised; looks through glass; returns halfway. This expresses asking for information, not waving or sleeping.
ROW 2 HANDWRITING: girl holds a small writing pad and pencil. Frames pencil poised; pencil touches paper; short writing stroke; pencil lifts, all while looking down attentively. Keep body still, pencil-hand movement clear, no page-turn animation and no bounce.
ROW 3 MOVE OBJECT: girl firmly holds one small cardboard box with both hands. Frames stands with box; leans and pulls box a little left; leans and pushes box a little right; steadies box at center. Feet remain near the same ground anchor, physical effort and bent arms. This is moving a whole object, not stretching an arrow or changing its size.
ROW 4 BACKGROUND WORK: girl is tinkering with one small gear held at chest height while the other hand adjusts it using a tiny tool. Frames tool raised; touches gear; gear turns quarter rotation; tool lifts. Calm awake smile, productive busy task while still available, not blocked waiting, not sleeping, not jumping.
Uniform character proportions and hairstyle across the entire sheet, with clear readable hand-held props; each row must communicate its own functional task through the character action itself. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no matte, no checkerboard.
